Name: Relief: Pinned Surveyor on <Alias=TargetPlanetLocation>
MissionBoardDescription: Relief contract. A survey detail is pinned down at the <Alias=TargetLocation> on <Alias=TargetPlanetLocation>, with one wounded. Clear the site and reach them. Expect the occupiers to call for more. Payment on contract completion.

LogEntries.Entry: A survey detail walked into the <Alias=TargetLocation> thinking it was empty. It wasn't. Two of them got out; one is still in there, wounded.
The occupiers called for help the moment they saw me, and it came down in pods. It's dead now. Their leader is still at the <Alias=TargetLocation>, and so is the wounded surveyor.
The occupiers' leader at the <Alias=TargetLocation> is dead. The surveyor they had pinned is still alive.
A survey detail walked into the <Alias=TargetLocation> thinking it was empty. I cleared the reinforcements, took down the leader and got the one they left behind back on her feet.

Objectives.DisplayText: Clear the occupiers' reinforcements at the <Alias=TargetLocation>
Defeat the occupiers' leader at the <Alias=TargetLocation>

Lines.ResponseText: You came. I didn't think anyone would take that posting.
We were only here to survey the place. They've had me down by this wall since the morning, and my leg's no good.
If you go slowly, and you don't mind the swearing.
Get me back to my ship. I'll tell the office you earned every credit.
The listing said it was abandoned.
Two of us ran for the ship when it started.
They called it in. That's why you're here, so I can't even be angry with them.
Slowly. I bite when I'm scared.
You're close? I can hear your engines.
They'll call for more as soon as they see you. Deal with that first, then come and find me.
Their boss is still in there. So am I.
It's gone quiet. Is that you?
I'm by the wall. I'd wave, but it hurts.
